quote: One concern per module; avoid cross-importing between route files
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, route modules should not import from other route modules.

quote: Use `async def` for route handlers; use `await` for all I/O
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, FastAPI route handlers must be declared with `async def`.

quote: Use `async def` for route handlers; use `await` for all I/O
statement: In tinyagentos/ async route handlers, all I/O must be awaited (no blocking synchronous I/O calls inside async handlers).

quote: Persist state with `tinyagentos.atomic_io` (`atomic_write_text` / `atomic_write_bytes`), never a hand-rolled write-temp-then-rename: the hand-rolled form fsyncs nothing
statement: In tinyagentos/**, code persisting state files must call tinyagentos.atomic_io.atomic_write_text / atomic_write_bytes and must not hand-roll a write-temp-then-rename (tmp.write_text + tmp.replace).

quote: Create one-time key material with `atomic_create_bytes`, not `atomic_write_bytes`: a write is a *replace*
statement: In tinyagentos/**, code creating one-time key material must use tinyagentos.atomic_io.atomic_create_bytes, not atomic_write_bytes.

quote: Await a durable write from async code (`await asyncio.to_thread(...)`): the two fsyncs are blocking syscalls and stall the whole event loop
statement: In tinyagentos/** async functions, durable atomic_io writes must be run via `await asyncio.to_thread(atomic_write_text, ...)`, not called directly.

quote: Follow existing React patterns in `desktop/src/` - no server-rendered templates for new features
statement: New UI features must be built in the React SPA under desktop/src/ and must not add new server-rendered (Jinja) templates under tinyagentos/templates/.

quote: ARIA labels are required on interactive elements without visible text labels
statement: In desktop/src/** React components, interactive elements without visible text labels must carry an ARIA label (aria-label/aria-labelledby).

quote: One concern per component; keep API calls in dedicated hooks or service files
statement: In desktop/src/**, API calls should live in dedicated hooks or service files rather than inline in components.

quote: Use pytest; fixtures live in `tests/conftest.py` - use them
statement: In tests/**, tests must be written with pytest and use the shared fixtures from tests/conftest.py rather than re-creating them.

quote: Mirror the module structure: `tinyagentos/routes/agents.py` -> `tests/test_routes_agents.py`
statement: Test files must mirror the module structure: tests for tinyagentos/<pkg>/<mod>.py live in tests/test_<pkg>_<mod>.py (e.g. tests/test_routes_agents.py).

quote: Every taOS surface is a live surface: new or changed UI must auto-refresh and carry motion per `docs/design/live-surface-law.md`. PRs adding a static screen get bounced on review.
statement: In desktop/src/** surfaces, new or changed UI must auto-refresh its data and animate state changes; static fetch-once screens are not allowed.

quote: When adding a feature, add tests that cover the new behaviour. When fixing a bug, add a regression test.
statement: Every feature change must add tests covering the new behaviour and every bug fix must add a regression test under tests/.

quote: Declare what it guards with `@pytest.mark.guards("module:function", replace=[(correct_snippet, defective_snippet)])` and `scripts/check_non_discriminating.py` re-runs it against that broken variant; it must fail there.
statement: In tests/**, guard tests should be decorated with @pytest.mark.guards("module:function", replace=[(correct, defective)]) and must not monkeypatch the function they guard.

quote: Route modules access stores via `request.app.state` (dependency injection set up in the app lifespan) - they do not import stores directly.
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, route modules must access stores via request.app.state and must not import store modules/classes directly.

quote: All fields except `config_schema` are required. The `hardware_tiers` block controls which hardware profiles see the app as recommended.
statement: In app-catalog/**/manifest.yaml, every field (id, name, type, version, description, homepage, license, requires, install, hardware_tiers) except config_schema must be present.

quote: Pick the appropriate category and create a directory named after your app's `id`
statement: Catalog apps must live at app-catalog/<category>/<id>/manifest.yaml where the directory name equals the manifest's id.

quote: Add an entry to `app-catalog/catalog.yaml` under the appropriate section
statement: Every app manifest under app-catalog/ must have a matching entry (id, type, version, name, description) in app-catalog/catalog.yaml.

quote: NEVER install the "unidecode" extra: it pulls GPL-only Unidecode, which we keep out by choice (text-unidecode suffices).
statement: In pyproject.toml and tinyagentos/**, python-slugify must not be installed with the "unidecode" extra and the GPL Unidecode package must not be depended on or imported.

quote: Every new endpoint needs an explicit auth gate and a negative test. A new route is unauthenticated until proven otherwise. Add the guard (admin session + CSRF, or the agent-token allowlist in `auth_middleware.py`)
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, every new endpoint must have an explicit auth guard (admin session + CSRF, or an entry in the agent-token allowlist in tinyagentos/auth_middleware.py).

quote: and a test asserting an unauthenticated or cross-principal caller gets 401/403.
statement: In tests/**, every new endpoint must have a negative test asserting an unauthenticated or cross-principal caller receives 401/403.

quote: For project-scoped routes, copy the house guard verbatim: `if not user.is_admin and user.user_id != p["user_id"]` followed by a masked 404 (see routes/projects.py). A bare 403 without the admin bypass both locks out admins and leaks resource existence
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/** project-scoped routes, ownership checks must use `if not user.is_admin and user.user_id != p["user_id"]` and respond with a masked 404, not a bare 403.

quote: When a message or envelope arrives over an authenticated channel, verify BOTH that `from` matches the authenticated peer (sender binding, blocks impersonation) and that `to` matches the local identity (audience binding, blocks relay abuse).
statement: In tinyagentos/** authenticated-channel message handlers, code must check both that the envelope `from` equals the authenticated peer and that `to` equals the local identity.

quote: If a change makes missing secrets or config reject requests, never weaken that behavior to make tests pass. Provision the secret in the test environment (CI job `env:` or fixtures) instead.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, fail-closed behaviour on missing secrets/config must not be weakened to make tests pass; tests must provision the secret via fixtures or CI env.

quote: Secrets live in SecretsStore, never in config files. Anything sensitive (private keys, tokens) goes through SecretsStore encrypted at rest, with a migration that moves any legacy plaintext value out of config and strips it.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, sensitive values (private keys, tokens) must be stored through SecretsStore and must not be written to config files such as config.yaml.

quote: Tokens we only VERIFY are stored hashed; tokens we must PRESENT outbound are the only ones stored recoverable.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, tokens that are only verified must be stored hashed; only tokens presented outbound may be stored recoverably.

quote: A PR that introduces a component writing under `data/` must add that directory to `.gitignore` in the SAME PR
statement: Any component that writes runtime state under data/ must have that directory listed in .gitignore.

quote: Never take element `[0]` of a collection that can hold more than one. If a lookup returns a list (installations, grants, devices), resolve the RIGHT element for the context or handle all of them.
statement: In tinyagentos/** and desktop/src/**, code must not index `[0]` into a lookup result that can hold multiple elements (installations, grants, devices); it must select the correct element or handle all.

quote: A size cap documented "on the wire" must measure the wire form (base64 inflates about 33 percent). Pick one authoritative form, measure that, and make the docstring match.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, size limits must be measured on the same encoding they are documented against (e.g. base64 wire form), matching the docstring.

quote: Store timestamps in UTC. Server-local timestamps corrupt data the moment the host timezone differs. Convert at the edge, store UTC.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, persisted timestamps must be UTC (e.g. datetime.now(timezone.utc)), not server-local time (naive datetime.now()).

quote: Note `datetime.fromisoformat()` only accepts a trailing `Z` on Python 3.11+; use `+00:00` in examples and normalize input.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, ISO timestamp input should be normalized (trailing Z to +00:00) before datetime.fromisoformat(), and examples should use +00:00.

quote: No empty catch blocks. Swallowing a fetch or IO failure and rendering an empty state reads as "no data" when the truth is "request failed". Surface the error (toast, inline state, log).
statement: In desktop/src/** and tinyagentos/**, catch/except blocks must not be empty or silently swallow fetch/IO failures; errors must be surfaced (toast, inline state, or log).

quote: Refactors must preserve behavior, or say loudly that they do not.
statement: Refactors that extract or split a component must preserve its capability list, or explicitly state dropped behaviour.

quote: No hardcoded placeholder arguments. `permissions: []` hardcoded at a call site means every save writes empty permissions. Wire the real value or do not add the parameter yet.
statement: In desktop/src/** and tinyagentos/**, call sites must not pass hardcoded placeholder arguments (e.g. `permissions: []`) in place of the real value.

quote: Persist state through `tinyagentos.atomic_io`, never a hand-rolled temp-plus-replace. ... a promotion that genuinely cannot use `atomic_io` (swapping a symlink, say) is waived in place with a `# atomic-io-exempt: <reason>` comment on the same line.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, state files must be written with atomic_write_text / atomic_write_bytes from tinyagentos.atomic_io; any hand-rolled tmp.write_text + tmp.replace must carry a same-line `# atomic-io-exempt: <reason>` comment.

quote: One-time key material is *created*, not written. ... Use `atomic_create_bytes`, which claims the name with `link(2)` and hands a losing process the bytes that actually persisted.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, one-time key material files (e.g. .secrets_key, hub/identity.json) must be created with atomic_create_bytes, not atomic_write_bytes.

quote: A durable write from `async` code goes through `await asyncio.to_thread(atomic_write_text, ...)`.
statement: In tinyagentos/** async functions, atomic_io durable writes must be wrapped in `await asyncio.to_thread(...)`.

quote: A new view must be wired into every surface it has: desktop AND mobile. The desktop tab list and the mobile tab order are separate registries; updating one and not the other ships a view that is unreachable on phones (#2042: `TABS` updated, `mobileTabOrder` missed).
statement: In desktop/src/**, a new view added to a desktop tab registry (e.g. TABS) must also be added to the mobile registry (e.g. mobileTabOrder) and every other registry its siblings appear in.

quote: SCHEMA is the frozen v1; new columns and their indexes go in MIGRATIONS. Never index a migration-added column inside SCHEMA
statement: In tinyagentos/** BaseStore subclasses, new columns and their indexes must be added via MIGRATIONS and SCHEMA must never index a migration-added column.

quote: Migrations are idempotent. Running a data migration twice must be a no-op (existence checks, INSERT OR IGNORE, migrated-from markers)
statement: In tinyagentos/** store migrations, data migrations must be idempotent (existence checks, INSERT OR IGNORE, migrated-from markers).

quote: and there must be a test proving the second run changes nothing.
statement: In tests/**, each data migration must have a test that runs it twice and asserts the second run changes nothing.

quote: Retrofitting a column onto an already-shipped store needs a guarded ALTER, not just a MIGRATIONS entry. ... Use the guarded `_post_init` pattern (PRAGMA table_info, ALTER only when the column is absent
statement: In tinyagentos/** stores, adding a column to an already-shipped table must use a guarded `_post_init` (PRAGMA table_info, ALTER TABLE only when the column is absent), not only a MIGRATIONS entry.

quote: and add an upgrade test that builds the PRE-change schema first. Fresh-DB tests are structurally blind to this class
statement: In tests/**, a schema/column change to a store must include an upgrade test that first builds the pre-change schema, not only a fresh-DB test.

quote: Adding a column straight into SCHEMA bricks every existing install. ... only a `_post_init` defined as a METHOD of the store class silences a column - a module-level helper of that name is not the hook `BaseStore.init()` calls.
statement: In tinyagentos/** stores, a new column must not be added to the CREATE TABLE body in SCHEMA of an existing table; it must be retrofitted in a `_post_init` method defined on the store class (not a module-level function).

quote: A `SCHEMA` the guard cannot resolve to a static string in its own file (an f-string with a runtime value, or a constant imported from another module) is reported on stderr as NOT checked rather than skipped silently; keep the SQL literal in the same file
statement: In tinyagentos/** stores, SCHEMA should be a static string literal defined in the store's own file, not an f-string with runtime values or a constant imported from another module.

quote: A tolerance is not a test of an invariant. An assertion like `assert abs(after - before) <= 2` cannot distinguish correct behaviour from catastrophic failure. ... If the property is "the count does not change", assert equality and assert the resulting status
statement: In tests/**, invariants (e.g. counts that must not change) must be asserted with equality plus the resulting status, not with tolerance assertions like `abs(a - b) <= n`; tolerances are only for approximate quantities such as timings.

quote: Shell snippets inside template literals must escape `${`. ... Escape as `\${`, or keep snippets in plain non-template strings or separate asset files.
statement: In desktop/src/** TypeScript/JavaScript, bash or PowerShell snippets stored in template literals must escape shell `${...}` as `\${`, or use plain strings/separate asset files.

quote: Genuinely third-party (GitHub, OpenRouter, Reddit): capture, do not compose. There is no one to ask, so call the real service once and commit its response as the fixture.
statement: In tests/**, fixtures mocking third-party services (GitHub, OpenRouter, Reddit) must be captured real responses, not hand-composed.

quote: Keep one real integration test per external contract. Have it feature detect and skip when the service is unreachable
statement: In tests/**, each external service contract should have at least one real integration test that feature-detects the service and skips when unreachable.

quote: If that is impossible, mark the mock provisional IN CODE with the contract source and the date it was verified. A follow-up issue is not sufficient
statement: In tests/**, a mock of an external service contract without a real integration test must be marked provisional in a code comment naming the contract source and the date it was verified.

quote: Routes - each `routes/*.py` is an `APIRouter` registered in `tinyagentos/routes/__init__.py`'s `register_all_routers()` (called from `create_app()`) with `dependencies=_csrf`.
statement: Each tinyagentos/routes/*.py module must expose an APIRouter that is registered in tinyagentos/routes/__init__.py register_all_routers() with dependencies=_csrf.

quote: `async def` handlers, `await` all I/O, Pydantic request/response models.
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, route handlers should use Pydantic models for request bodies and responses.

quote: they do **not** import stores directly. **No cross-importing between route modules.**
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, route modules must not import other route modules.

quote: Routes access stores via `request.app.state` (dependency injection set up in the app lifespan) - they do **not** import stores directly.
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, routes must obtain stores from request.app.state and must not import store modules directly.

quote: Stores - SQLite via `aiosqlite`; each subclasses `BaseStore` (`tinyagentos/base_store.py`), sets `SCHEMA` (first-open DDL) and `MIGRATIONS`, and is attached to `request.app.state` in the lifespan
statement: In tinyagentos/**, data stores must subclass BaseStore from tinyagentos/base_store.py, use aiosqlite, and define SCHEMA and MIGRATIONS.

quote: Never reference a migration-added column inside `SCHEMA`.
statement: In tinyagentos/** BaseStore subclasses, SCHEMA must never reference a column added by MIGRATIONS.

quote: Config - `AppConfig` dataclass in `config.py`; YAML serialisation; async-locked saves via `save_config_locked()`
statement: In tinyagentos/**, AppConfig saves from async code must go through save_config_locked() (async-locked), not an unlocked save.

quote: One legacy Jinja template exists (`agent_debugger.html`); if you must touch it, match its existing Pico CSS + htmx style.
statement: Edits to tinyagentos/templates/agent_debugger.html should use the existing Pico CSS + htmx style.

quote: Never hand-edit it and never fetch prices at runtime.
statement: In tinyagentos/llm_usage/**, LLM prices must be read from the vendored data/model_prices.json and must never be fetched over the network at runtime.

quote: Never hand-edit it and never fetch prices at runtime. Refresh it with `python scripts/update_model_prices.py [<sha>]`
statement: tinyagentos/llm_usage/data/model_prices.json is generated and must not be hand-edited; it is regenerated only by scripts/update_model_prices.py.

quote: An unknown price must stay `usd=None`, never `0.0`: the budget code only charges `cost > 0`.
statement: In tinyagentos/llm_usage/**, an unknown model price must be represented as usd=None, never 0.0.

quote: If you build your own `AsyncClient`, it will 403 on mutating routes once it carries a `taos_session` cookie. Fix it the way the real caller does - send the header - not by disabling the check.
statement: In tests/**, a hand-built httpx AsyncClient carrying a taos_session cookie must pass event_hooks=csrf_event_hooks() from tests/taos_test_csrf.py instead of disabling CSRF.

quote: It lives in its own module, not in `conftest.py`, because `tests/` is not a package and several `conftest.py` files exist, so a bare `from conftest import ...` binds whichever one is on `sys.path` first.
statement: In tests/**, test modules must not import helpers via `from conftest import ...`; shared helpers go in their own module (e.g. tests/taos_test_csrf.py).

quote: `@pytest.mark.csrf_bypass` exists but nothing uses it, and `tests/test_csrf_bypass_debt.py` asserts the list stays EMPTY. ... Do NOT add it to silence a new red
statement: In tests/**, tests must not use the @pytest.mark.csrf_bypass marker.

quote: Every pytest marker is declared once, in `pyproject.toml` under `[tool.pytest.ini_options] markers`. Do NOT register one from a `pytest_configure` hook in `tests/conftest.py`
statement: Pytest markers must be declared only in pyproject.toml [tool.pytest.ini_options] markers; tests/conftest.py must not register markers via an additional pytest_configure hook.

quote: Like `csrf_bypass`, nothing uses it, and `tests/test_embed_backend_marker_debt.py` asserts the list stays EMPTY. Before adding it, check what the test actually calls.
statement: In tests/**, @pytest.mark.skip_if_no_embed_backend should not be applied, and never to tests that do not actually reach an embedding backend (mocked clients, patched setup).

quote: `register_all_routers` does `from ... import verify_csrf` and freezes the object into `Depends(...)` at `include_router` time, so patching the module attribute AFTER `create_app` does nothing.
statement: In tests/**, any stub of verify_csrf must be applied before create_app() is called, not by patching the module attribute afterwards.

quote: New route: `routes/<feature>.py` with `router = APIRouter()` → register in `tinyagentos/routes/__init__.py::register_all_routers()` with `dependencies=_csrf`, honoring the ordering comments there ...; do **not** add `include_router` inline in `app.py`
statement: New routers must be defined as `router = APIRouter()` in tinyagentos/routes/<feature>.py and included only in register_all_routers() (honoring its ordering comments); tinyagentos/app.py must not call include_router inline.

quote: → tests in `tests/test_<feature>.py` using the `client` fixture.
statement: Tests for a new route module tinyagentos/routes/<feature>.py should live in tests/test_<feature>.py and use the shared async `client` fixture.

quote: blocks PRs that add a new `BaseStore` subclass without wiring it into `tinyagentos/app.py`. Routes reach stores ONLY via `request.app.state`, so an unwired store is unreachable dead code.
statement: Every new BaseStore subclass that declares SCHEMA must be wired into tinyagentos/app.py (attached as app.state.<name> in the lifespan).

quote: Config field: add to config dataclass → update defaults + `to_dict()`/`from_dict()` → `test_config.py`.
statement: In tinyagentos/config.py, a new config field must be added to the config dataclass with a default and handled in both to_dict() and from_dict(), with coverage in tests/test_config.py.

quote: Writing a state file: call `atomic_write_text` / `atomic_write_bytes` from `tinyagentos.atomic_io` ... Never hand-roll `tmp.write_text(...)` + `tmp.replace(target)`
statement: In tinyagentos/**, state files must be written via tinyagentos.atomic_io.atomic_write_text/atomic_write_bytes, never tmp.write_text + tmp.replace (exemptions need `# atomic-io-exempt: <reason>`).

quote: Creating one-time key material: call `atomic_create_bytes`, not `atomic_write_bytes`.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, one-time key material must be created with atomic_create_bytes rather than atomic_write_bytes.

quote: Any SPA `fetch` that POSTs/PUTs/PATCHes/DELETEs must attach the double-submit header: use `withCsrf(init)` from `desktop/src/lib/csrf.ts`, or the `taosFetch` wrapper (`desktop/src/lib/taos-fetch.ts`) ... A raw `fetch("/api/...", {method:"POST"})` passes vitest but 403s
statement: In desktop/src/**, mutating requests (POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE) to /api must use taosFetch from desktop/src/lib/taos-fetch.ts or wrap init with withCsrf() from desktop/src/lib/csrf.ts; raw fetch with a mutating method is forbidden.

quote: Access derives from an ACTIVE grant per `(agent, project)` - not from token claims - and no-grant yields an existence-hiding 404.
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/** agent-facing routes, access must be derived from an active (agent, project) grant lookup, not from JWT claims, and a missing grant must return a 404.

quote: Agent/registry JWTs only reach explicitly allowlisted `(method, path)` pairs in `tinyagentos/auth_middleware.py`. A new agent-facing *mutating* route silently 401s until it is added there
statement: Every agent-facing route (especially mutating ones) must have its (method, path) pair added to the agent-token allowlist in tinyagentos/auth_middleware.py.

quote: Every adapter in `tinyagentos/adapters/__init__.py` declares `verification_status: tested | beta | experimental | broken` (plus `tracking_issue`, required for `broken`).
statement: In tinyagentos/adapters/__init__.py, every adapter must declare verification_status as one of tested|beta|experimental|broken, and adapters marked broken must also set tracking_issue.

quote: A new or edited adapter must set this correctly - defaulting a new framework to `experimental` is the norm until it passes round-trip verification.
statement: In tinyagentos/adapters/**, a new framework adapter should default to verification_status experimental until it passes round-trip verification.

quote: Python 3.11+ floor (pyproject.toml: `>=3.11,<3.15`). `match`/`case` and `X | None` union syntax are available. Most modules use `from __future__ import annotations`.
statement: In tinyagentos/**/*.py, modules should start with `from __future__ import annotations` and code must not rely on syntax newer than Python 3.11.

quote: CI does run a `lint` job (`python -m compileall tinyagentos/`), so any syntax error fails CI
statement: All Python under tinyagentos/ must byte-compile without syntax errors (python -m compileall tinyagentos/).
enforced_by: CI lint job: python -m compileall tinyagentos/ -q (.github/workflows/ci.yml)

quote: `tinyagentos/secrets.py` (routes in `tinyagentos/routes/secrets.py`, attached as `app.state.secrets`) is the credential store. Store credentials there - never in config or in code.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, credentials must be stored via the secrets store (tinyagentos/secrets.py, app.state.secrets) and never hardcoded in code or written to config.

quote: `verify_csrf` must be typed `HTTPConnection` (the shared base of `Request` and `WebSocket`) so it is injectable on both scopes ... a plain `Request` param (or `Request | None`) `TypeError`s on a websocket route
statement: Router-wide dependencies such as verify_csrf must type their connection parameter as starlette HTTPConnection, not Request or Request | None, so they work on websocket routes.

quote: Do session auth *inside* the handler (see `chat_ws` in `routes/chat.py`).
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/**, @router.websocket handlers must perform session authentication inside the handler body (as chat_ws in routes/chat.py does).

quote: `_ALLOWED_SCOPES` (`routes/agent_registry.py`) and `VALID_SCOPES` (`routes/agent_auth_requests.py`) must stay equal - a test asserts `set(_ALLOWED_SCOPES) == set(VALID_SCOPES)`. Add any new scope to **both**.
statement: _ALLOWED_SCOPES in tinyagentos/routes/agent_registry.py and VALID_SCOPES in tinyagentos/routes/agent_auth_requests.py must contain the same scopes.

quote: The data layer is many separate SQLite files - one file per store, not one shared DB. There is no cross-store SQL and migrations are per-store.
statement: In tinyagentos/** stores, each store owns its own SQLite file and SQL must not query across stores' tables; migrations are defined per store.

quote: **One concern per module.** No cross-importing between route modules.
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, route modules must not import other route modules.

quote: **Routes access stores via `request.app.state`** (dependency injection), not by importing stores directly.
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, routes must access stores via request.app.state, not by importing stores.

quote: **All real UI work goes in the `desktop/` React SPA.** One legacy Jinja template exists (`agent_debugger.html`); if you must touch it, match its Pico CSS + htmx style.
statement: UI work must be implemented in the desktop/ React SPA; no new Jinja templates beyond tinyagentos/templates/agent_debugger.html.

quote: **Semantic HTML; ARIA labels** on interactive elements without visible text.
statement: In desktop/src/** components, markup must use semantic HTML elements and interactive elements without visible text must have ARIA labels.

quote: **`async def`** route handlers; **`await`** all I/O.
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, route handlers must be `async def` and all I/O must be awaited.

quote: **Pydantic** request/response models.
statement: In tinyagentos/routes/*.py, request and response bodies must be modelled with Pydantic models.

quote: **Routes** register in `tinyagentos/routes/__init__.py`'s `register_all_routers()` (called from `create_app()`), each with `dependencies=_csrf`; do not add `include_router` inline in `app.py`.
statement: Routers must be included only in tinyagentos/routes/__init__.py register_all_routers() with dependencies=_csrf; tinyagentos/app.py must not call include_router inline.

quote: **Stores** subclass `BaseStore` (`tinyagentos/base_store.py`) with `SCHEMA` + `MIGRATIONS`, attached in the lifespan. Never reference a migration-added column in `SCHEMA`; retrofit columns via a guarded `_post_init`
statement: In tinyagentos/**, stores must subclass BaseStore with SCHEMA and MIGRATIONS, never reference migration-added columns in SCHEMA, and retrofit columns via a guarded _post_init.

quote: **Config** uses the `AppConfig` dataclass; YAML serialisation; async-locked saves via `save_config_locked()`.
statement: In tinyagentos/**, config must be represented by the AppConfig dataclass and saved via save_config_locked().

quote: Every surface MUST refetch its data when it regains focus or becomes visible again. The **S1 hook** is the intended mechanism once landed (see PR 2220) ... Fetch-on-mount-once is forbidden.
statement: In desktop/src/** surfaces, data must be refetched on window focus and visibilitychange (via the S1 hook once landed); fetch-on-mount-once is forbidden.

quote: Every surface MUST subscribe to the OS event stream for push updates. ... Polling is a fallback only when the stream is unavailable, never the primary path.
statement: In desktop/src/** surfaces, push updates must come from a subscription to the OS SSE event stream (S2 hook once landed); polling may only be a fallback when the stream is unavailable.

quote: State changes animate where motion aids comprehension: list insert/remove, card move, status flip, pending-to-ready transitions. Transitions are smooth and respect `prefers-reduced-motion`.
statement: In desktop/src/** surfaces, list insert/remove, card moves and status transitions should animate, and all animations must respect prefers-reduced-motion.

quote: Any PR that touches an existing app or surface that does not follow this convention MUST bring that surface up to the convention in the same PR
statement: Any change touching an existing desktop/src/** surface must bring it up to the live-surface convention (S1/S2 hooks, transitions) in the same change.
scope: desktop/src/** app surfaces touched by a change

quote: TinyAgentOS manages all external messaging connections. Frameworks never touch Telegram/Discord APIs directly.
statement: Agent framework adapters (tinyagentos/adapters/**) must not call messaging platform APIs (Telegram, Discord, etc.) directly; all external messaging goes through tinyagentos/channel_hub.
